name: Antiquarian
desc:
Antiquarians are NPCs that purchase certain items. They are typically your main source of Notes.

They can be found in:

-   [Isle of Vigils](location:isle_of_vigils) (right next to the banker)
-   [Isle of Vigils](location:isle_of_vigils) (in the Library, there are two at Vigils total)
-   [Etris](location:etris) (right behind the lumberjack quest)
-   [Greathive Aratel](location:greathive_aratel) (in the Root Plaza)
-   [Summer Isle](location:summer_isle) (just to the right of the gun seller)
-   [Miner's Landing](location:miners_landing) (in the town)
-   [Castle Light](location:castle_light) (but only people with the Deepbound Origin can interact with them)
-   [Chariot's Spire](location:the_chariots_spire) (but only people with the Ignition Delver Origin can interact with them)
-   [Fort Merit](location:fort_merit)
-   [Voidheart](location:voidheart) (next to the spawn, opposite side of the bounty board).
-   [The Floating Keep](location:the_floating_keep)
-   Player Guild Base (right next to the stairs at the entrance, however only if your guild base has a total of 9 rooms - this can be checked by counting them or, more easily, clicking your guild’s icon on the leaderboard.)
-   [Saramaed Hollow](location:saramaed_hollow)
